The proposed final answer of 1 cannot be correct. Every boundary between lilypads i and i+1 is crossed at least twice, because the cycle must go out and come back. The total distance is therefore at least 2(n−1), so f(n)/n is at least about 2 for large n. A limit of 1 is impossible.

The proposed solution also stops after setting up the crossing-number framework and never derives the answer.

VERDICT: REJECT
